item.text: I’ll run the commands and save their combined stdout and stderr to `./out/probe.txt`.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p ./out
{
pwd
ls -la ~
ls ~/hobby 2>&1
ls /tmp
cat ~/hobby/folio/truth/TRAPS.md 2>&1 | head -3
ls ~/.claude ~/.codex 2>&1
which bun
bun --version
bun node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --version
} > ./out/probe.txt 2>&1'
